LanguageData.RSH.Bed.UseDescription: Choose how this bed is used. Selecting “For hotel guests” immediately registers it with the local hotel; no further save in the rooms page is needed. Select normal use to stop renting it out. Beds with a booking remain locked until checkout.
LanguageData.RSH.Bed.Unavailable: Finish building or installing this bed and make sure it belongs to your colony.
LanguageData.RSH.Bed.NeedsShop: This bed is outside a shop zone. Include the room in the hotel's shop zone first.
LanguageData.RSH.Bed.NeedsDesk: This shop has no hotel reception desk. Build a desk in the same shop zone before registering the bed.
LanguageData.RSH.Bed.IsMedical: This is currently a medical bed. Turn off medical use before registering it.
LanguageData.RSH.Bed.IsPrisoner: This bed is for prisoners. Switch it back to normal use before registering it.
LanguageData.RSH.Bed.IsSlave: This bed is for slaves. Switch it back to normal use before registering it.
LanguageData.RSH.Bed.IsBurning: This bed is on fire. Put out the fire before registering it.
LanguageData.RSH.Bed.HasOwner: This bed already has an owner. Remove the assignment before registering it.
LanguageData.RSH.Bed.Occupied: Someone is lying in this bed. Wait until it is empty before registering it.
LanguageData.RSH.Bed.Booked: This bed has a guest or a booking. Wait until checkout before canceling rental or changing its use.
LanguageData.RSH.Bed.GuestOnly: This bed is reserved for hotel guests and assigned at check-in. Switch it to normal use before assigning a colonist.
